# Libraries

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(Matrix)
library(anndataR)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)

# Project paths
project_dir <- "/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project"
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "DATA")
datah_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "DATAH")
out_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "OUT", "LU_adc")

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

source(file.path(project_dir, "functions.R"))
```

# Dataset configuration

The LU-ADC datasets are stored as `.h5ad` files.  
Unlike the CRC pipeline, cell metadata are read directly from the AnnData `obs`
table and the expression matrix in `X` is treated as already normalized.

```{r}
datasets <- list(

  GSE131907 = list(
    h5ad = file.path(
      datah_dir,
      "lu_adc_GSE131907.h5ad"
    ),
    save = file.path(
      out_dir,
      "obj_GSE131907.rds"
    )
  ),

  GSE123902 = list(
    h5ad = file.path(
      datah_dir,
      "lu_adc_GSE123902.h5ad"
    ),
    save = file.path(
      out_dir,
      "obj_GSE123902.rds"
    )
  ),

  codeocean = list(
    h5ad = file.path(
      datah_dir,
      "lu_adc_codeocean.h5ad"
    ),
    save = file.path(
      out_dir,
      "obj_codeocean.rds"
    )
  )
)
```

# H5AD loading and Seurat object creation

Each h5ad file is converted independently into a Seurat object.

`load_h5ad_to_seurat()` is expected to:

- transpose AnnData `X` from cells × genes to genes × cells;
- read metadata directly from `ad$obs`;
- preserve the already-normalized expression values in the `data` layer;
- rename `Celltype` to `Cell_type` when needed;
- preserve gene and cell identifiers.

```{r}
obj_list <- list()

for (name in names(datasets)) {

  cat("Processing dataset:", name, "\n")

  obj_list[[name]] <- load_h5ad_to_seurat(
    h5ad_file = datasets[[name]]$h5ad,
    save_path = datasets[[name]]$save
  )

  cat("Completed dataset:", name, "\n\n")
}

print(names(obj_list))

saveRDS(obj_list, file.path(out_dir, "obj_list.rds"))
```

# Merge Datasets

```{r}
merged_obj <- merge_seurat_objects(obj_list = obj_list, save_path = file.path(out_dir, "merged_seurat_qc.rds"))

# Check Merged objs

dim(merged_obj)

print(merged_obj)

table(merged_obj$GSE)

head(merged_obj@meta.data)

# Remove obj_list

rm(obj_list)
gc()
```

# QC Visualization

Unlike the CRC datasets, the LU-ADC datasets are imported from `.h5ad` files
containing already normalized expression values in `X`. Therefore,
`nCount_RNA` represents the sum of normalized expression values rather than
raw UMI counts. In addition, `percent.mt` is not calculated during LU-ADC import,
since raw count matrices are not available in these objects.

For this reason, the LU-ADC QC visualization includes `nFeature_RNA` and
`nCount_RNA`, while `percent.mt`, used in the CRC pipeline, is omitted.

```{r}
# merged_obj <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "merged_seurat_qc.rds"))

obj <- merged_obj

# define dataset colors (consistent palette)
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(obj$GSE)))

VlnPlot(
  obj,
  features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"),
  group.by = "GSE",
  cols = cols,
  ncol = 2,
  pt.size = 0
)
```

# Dimensionality Reduction

This section performs normalization, feature selection, scaling,
PCA, and UMAP embedding for downstream visualization.

This section prepares the merged object for dimensionality reduction.
Normalization is performed only when a normalized `data` layer is not already
available. Since the LU-ADC h5ad datasets contain normalized expression values,
the existing `data` layer is retained. Variable feature selection, scaling,
PCA, and UMAP are then performed as in the CRC pipeline.

```{r}
obj <- seurat_preprocess(obj)

obj <- FindVariableFeatures(
  obj,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000
)

obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj))

obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), npcs = 30)

ElbowPlot(obj)

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:15)
```

# Save Processed Object

Save the processed Seurat object after normalization and dimensionality reduction.

```{r}
saveRDS(obj, file.path(out_dir, "merged_normalized_hvgs.rds"))
```

# UMAP Visualization

This section visualizes batch effects across datasets using UMAP.

```{r}
DimPlot(obj, group.by = "GSE", cols = cols) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# Cell Type Annotation (Reference Labels)

This section performs cell type visualization, data preparation for
scMRMA, automated annotation, and validation against original labels.

## Original Cell Type Visualization

Visualize annotated cell types provided in the dataset.

```{r}
plot_cell_types(obj, "Cell_type")
```

## Prepare Data for scMRMA
  
Extract normalized expression matrix required for annotation.

```{r}
tmp <- prepare_scrmra_input(obj)

obj <- tmp$obj
logcounts <- tmp$logcounts
```
  
## Run scMRMA Annotation
  
Perform automated cell type prediction using reference-based annotation.

```{r}
obj <- run_scrmra_annotation(obj, logcounts)

# Save object with scMRMA annotations

saveRDS(obj, file.path(out_dir, "merged_scrmra_annotated.rds"))
```

## Annotation Validation
  
Compare original annotations with scMRMA predictions.

```{r}
obj <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "merged_scrmra_annotated.rds"))

df <- as.data.frame(table(obj$Cell_type, obj$cell_type1))
colnames(df) <- c("Original", "Validation", "Fraction")

ggplot(df, aes(x = Original, y = Fraction, fill = Validation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip()
```
  
# Re-check Visualization (Optional)
  
Visual confirmation of original labels.

```{r}
plot_cell_types(obj, "Cell_type")
```

# Cell type specificity

This section quantifies cell type specificity of lncRNAs and protein-coding genes
using the Gini coefficient computed from DotPlot-based expression summaries.

```{r}
# obj <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "merged_seurat_qc.rds"))

obj <- seurat_preprocess(obj)

gencode <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "gencode_v49_compatible.txt"), header = TRUE)

gene_sets <- gene_biotype_matching(obj, gencode)

lnc_features <- gene_sets$lnc
prot_features <- gene_sets$prot
ambiguous_genes <- gene_sets$ambiguous

chunk_size <- 2000

GiniCoef_lnc <- compute_gini_pipeline(obj, lnc_features, "lncRNA", chunk_size)
GiniCoef_prot <- compute_gini_pipeline(obj, prot_features, "protein_coding", chunk_size)

GiniCoef <- rbind(GiniCoef_lnc, GiniCoef_prot)
colnames(GiniCoef)[1] <- "gene"

saveRDS(GiniCoef, file.path(out_dir, "gini_dotplot_v49.rds"))

GiniCoef <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "gini_dotplot_v49.rds"))

GiniCoef_clean <- GiniCoef[!is.na(GiniCoef$gini), ]

lnc_n  <- nrow(GiniCoef_clean %>% filter(type == "lncRNA"))
prot_n <- nrow(GiniCoef_clean %>% filter(type == "protein_coding"))

plot_gini_results(GiniCoef_clean, lnc_n, prot_n)
```
